timeline.description: Around 50 residents at a north Delhi PG accommodation attended a police session regarding safety and protests. During the session, police advised students to avoid participating in a protest scheduled for October 10. They alleged that involvement could jeopardize future job prospects and lead to detention. Reports indicate police outreach extended to other student organizations and private coaching centers as well.

timeline.title: Jantar Mantar protest: Delhi hotels allege booking curbs; traders fear hit to business
timeline.description: Hotel associations in Delhi report that police have advised against accepting bookings from the Delhi-NCR area. Authorities are particularly focusing on guests coming for short stays around the protest date. Members are encouraged to verify visitors' reasons for their stay, including checking identity documents. The impact of these security measures on local businesses and ordinary residents is a significant concern.

Allegations of excessive force and illegal confinement arose after their detention and treatment by police authorities.
